# Instituto Tecnológico Superior de Libres

> > Instituto Tecnológico Superior de Libres (ITS Libres) - Higher education technology institute in Libres, Puebla, Mexico

ITS Libres is a public technological institute offering higher education programs in engineering and technology fields. The institution serves the Libres region in Puebla, Mexico, providing technical education and professional development opportunities.
